mobbin.applied: An ordered, named source route makes the active search path understandable without exposing a duplicate search editor.
Source-labelled image groups inform the last picture card: the frame the wall showed, with its source and when it was shown.
Inline management keeps saved connection details beside their status instead of opening another setup surface.

primary.applied: Google Custom Search JSON API is closed to new customers. Existing customers have until January 1, 2027. The optional existing-account connection is separated from Tessera’s built-in search. The explicit verification action explains its quota use.
